meta.title: Digital invitations with RSVP for any event
hero.title: Digital invitations with RSVP in one link
hero.sub: Guests reply on their phone and you see the count live in a Google Sheet you own. For weddings, birthdays, tahlil and any event.
mock.title: Sample Event
how.title: How it works
how.1d: Tell us about your event. We build a mobile invitation page with all the details.
how.2d: Send it on WhatsApp. Guests open it on their phone, no app needed.
how.3d: See who is coming and how many, live, in a Google Sheet that you own.
event.wedding.d: Invite family and guests, know the head-count before the caterer asks.
event.birthday.d: Parties big or small. Guests reply in seconds.
event.funeral.d: A simple, respectful page with time, place and directions for those who wish to attend.
event.other.d: Aqiqah, graduation, company dinner, reunion. If people need to reply, it works.
demo.title: See it before you book
get.title: What you get
get.1: A personal link for each important guest
get.2: One shared link for everyone else
get.3: Live reply list in your Google Sheet
get.4: Total number of guests, counted for you
get.5: RSVP deadline that closes the form
get.6: Map button so guests find the venue

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: It depends on your event. Contact us for a quote.
faq.q2: Do my guests need an app?
faq.a2: No. They open a link on their phone.
faq.a3: You do. Replies go into a Google Sheet that you own.
faq.q4: Can the invitation be in Bahasa Melayu only?
faq.a4: Yes. We write it in the language you choose.
faq.a5: Usually a few days once we have your event details. Ask us for your date.
